section_summary.extract_value: This section presents descriptive statistics for a study with 589 participants. It reports no significant ethnic differences in age or BMI, and no differences in marital status, but significant differences in religion. The mean score for the 13-item Body Appreciation Scale (BAS) was 3.63 for the total sample.
